key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; oil 'exploded' as OPEC+ suppression failed
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate-cut path
ANZ.AX post-3,500-job cuts faces long restructuring runway under new CEO
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices crashing while affordable segment and first-home buyers surge
Australian fuel prices set to rise ~30c/litre on global oil spike
Mining cap-raise activity surging (Canaccord-led), signalling sector stress
Gold exploration active (Kuniko, Gateway WA) but spot gold 'schmoulding'
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy-security fears

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore in active 'bloodletting'; ASX miners leading index losses. Cap-raise activity surging as juniors scramble for cash. Gold exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) active but spot gold weak.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Junior miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength. Cap raises dilute equity holders. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) underperform on weak spot gold.

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks sending ASX tumbling alongside miners. ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts still nascent. Rising bond yields and rate uncertainty pressure net interest margins.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face headwinds from rate-path uncertainty and credit-cycle concerns. ANZ restructuring may take 12-18 months to deliver cost savings. Mortgage rates rising ahead of CPI data.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive for producers, negative for consumers. Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; Australian fuel prices to rise ~30c. Santos preservation via policy sacrifice; gas supply rules softened.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from policy support and softer gas rules. Oil spike supports upstream but pressures downstream and transport. Fuel cost inflation feeds into CPI and RBA decisions.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths (WES.AX) breached 'Price Freeze' on four staples. Housing affordability stress. Business confidence deteriorating. Tax burden cited as crushing households.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CPL.AX face margin pressure from input costs and consumer squeeze. Housing crash benefits first-home buyers but hurts construction and REITs. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: Negative for high-end, resilient at affordable end. No spring bounce in auctions. High-end prices seeing steepest falls. RBA worried about rental inflation. Property chiefs calling for more migrants.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental inflation risk but also occupancy pressure. Housing correction may extend 6-12 months. First-home buyer surge supports government-linked equities.

sectors.trend: Selective. ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. Critical Resources battery tech passing month-long test. Limited large-cap tech exposure on ASX.
sectors.implications: Small-cap momentum plays offer tactical opportunities but high volatility. Battery/energy-storage theme (Critical Resources) aligns with global transition narrative.

key_themes: Oil price surge and fuel inflation driving global risk-off
Iron ore structural downturn pressuring ASX materials weight
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and commodity export revenue
Housing market bifurcation: luxury crash vs affordable resilience
Mining sector capital stress and dilution risk
US CPI data and Fed policy uncertainty spilling into ASX
Superannuation policy debate (One Nation, populism vs reform)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike and fuel inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel-cost exposure; favour energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over downstream/consumer names. Monitor OPEC+ output decisions.
Reduce overweight in BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold or diversified miners. Watch Chinese steel demand data.
Avoid rate-sensitive REITs and housing-linked equities until RBA path clarifies. Monitor CPI and rental data releases.
AUD weakness benefits exporters (miners, agribusiness) but hurts importers and consumer staples. Diversify currency exposure.
Avoid junior miners with imminent cap raises; favour well-funded majors or cash-flow-positive juniors.
Monitor US CPI release; Trump's trade-Fed linkage proposal adds policy risk. Maintain liquidity for volatility.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian energy producers on oil spike and policy support
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'exploded' as suppression failed; Santos preserved via policy; gas supply rules softened. WDS.AX and STO.AX benefit from higher realisation prices and regulatory tailwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical exposure to gold exploration on structural demand
opportunities.rationale: Active exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) and safe-haven flows despite weak spot gold. Geopolitical risk (Arctic shipping, G20 tensions) supports long-term gold thesis.
Critical Resources passing month-long battery test; global energy transition narrative intact. High risk/reward for allocated satellite positions.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce overweight in iron ore-exposed miners
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; structural demand concerns from China. BHP, RIO, FMG face 6-12 month margin compression.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-end REIT and luxury housing exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; no auction bounce; RBA rental inflation concern may delay rate cuts, pressuring valuations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash buffer ahead of US CPI and RBA commentary
defensive_moves.rationale: Oil spike, AUD weakness, and rate uncertainty create elevated volatility. Liquidity positions allow opportunistic deployment on pullbacks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid junior miners with pending cap raises
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led mining cap-raise wave signals sector-wide capital stress; dilution risk to existing holders.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower on oil-driven inflation fears, iron ore weakness, and AUD pressure. RBA rental-inflation concern limits rate-cut expectations. US CPI data is the key near-term catalyst. Expect 3-5% further index volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may create entry points for first-home buyer-linked equities. Energy transition and critical minerals (battery tech, gold) offer structural themes. Iron ore oversupply may persist 12-18 months. Superannuation reform debate could unlock long-term capital flows.
